axe.reason: The decorative icon is a text glyph (the vanilla adapter renders icons as text nodes), so axe cannot compute text contrast ("Element content contains only non-text characters"); the 3:1 non-text boundary is covered by the CSS contrast matrix.
axe cannot match the aria-label to a glyph that is aria-hidden and not a visible label; WCAG 2.5.3 applies to text labels.
